worked: Federal (given, not tested): federal AGI = wages (person 0) 160,000.00 = 160,000.00. Federal taxable income = 160,000.00 - standard deduction 31,500.00 = 128,500.00 (federal senior deduction ignored). Form ND-1 line 1b federal taxable income 128,500.00; lines 2-3 additions 0.00, line 4a 0.00; line 4b = 128,500.00. Subtractions lines 5-16: none; line 17 = 0.00. Line 18 North Dakota taxable income = 128,500.00 - 0.00 = 128,500.00. Line 19 = 128,500.00. Line 20 tax: 1.95% x (128,500.00 - 80,975.00) = 1.95% x 47,525.00 = 926.7375, to the cent 926.74; taxable income is 100,000 or more, so the form itself uses the schedule (PDF p.29). Lines 21-23 credits: line 22 marriage penalty credit: qualified income after lines 8 and 15 is 160,000.00 and 0.00; the lower is not more than 47,550.00, so none. Expected credits 0.00. Line 25 net tax = 926.74.
